title: servers.server_updated
description: ServerUpdated is published by servers when a server is created and every time its name, icon or owner changes. It is a full snapshot, not a diff, so consumers don't need the previous state. There is no version: the consumer keeps the snapshot with the newest occurred_at of each server, so a repeated or out-of-order delivery doesn't overwrite newer data (same rule as the permissions events). Built for admin's back-office listing, which shows the name, icon, owner and creation date of every server without asking servers.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

owner_id.description: ID del dueño del servidor (emitido por discordia-identify).

created_at.description: Fecha de creación del servidor, ISO 8601 en UTC. No cambia entre fotos.

icon_url.description: Dirección del ícono tal como la guarda servers: URL pública de Supabase Storage o ruta del gateway (`/v1/servers/{id}/icon?v=...`). Vacío si no tiene ícono. Los eventos anteriores a la versión 0.22.0 no lo traen: el consumidor lo toma como vacío.
